title: TGGMinecraft
description: A curated modpack tailored for the TGG Minecraft server, offering performance optimizations, enhanced visuals, quality-of-life improvements, and a more immersive multiplayer experience.
body:
[Discord](https://discord.gg/Gb5TSXhQrs) This modpack was built specifically for the TGG Minecraft server, removing the headache of individually sourcing and configuring mods. By including both client and server-side enhancements, this pack ensures that every player’s experience is streamlined—just install, connect, and play. Our selection focuses on boosting performance, refining graphics, and adding subtle yet impactful features.
Included Mods
- **Iris** by the Iris team (Adds shader compatibility and improved visual effects) - **Immersive Portals** by qouteall (Provides seamless portal transitions and non-Euclidean geometry) - **Sodium** by the caffeinemc team (Optimizes rendering performance and reduces lag) - **AppleSkin** by squeek502 (Enhances the food HUD with detailed hunger and saturation info)
